item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Sisi allowed peaceful protest or independent civic organization to operate freely and consistently. The positive evidence is limited to selective clemency and modest detention reform. I did not find a convincing counterweight showing sustained tolerance of unions, neighborhood groups, human-rights organizations, or protest movements without retaliation.","evidence":[{"title":"Egypt pardons prisoners on Police Day and January 25 Revolution","publisher":"Human Rights Studies - Egypt / SIS","date":"January 25, 2024","url":"https://hrightsstudies.sis.gov.eg/en/press/local/egypt-pardons-prisoners-on-Police-Day-and-January-25-Revolution/","summary":"Sisi signed a pardon for eligible prisoners, including some convicted for political expression, political activity, and social-solidarity offenses. This is a narrow positive signal for reducing retaliation against some dissent-related detainees, but it is episodic clemency rather than durable tolerance of peaceful protest.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.6","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Sisi orders government to act on National Dialogue recommendations","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"August 21, 2024","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/fr/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news2182024/","summary":"The presidency said Sisi told the government to shorten pretrial detention and activate alternatives to detention. This is the strongest official due-process reform signal in 2024, but it does not show broad protection for peaceful protest or civic organization.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.6","3B.4","3B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"May 13, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests of protesters, striking workers, and online critics, plus dispersal of protests and a case of beatings/electroshock without proper investigation. This is direct evidence of retaliation against peaceful dissent, not permission to organize without fear.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"July 18, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Security forces arrested 119 people after protest calls, used incommunicado detention, blindfolding, and broad terrorism/false-news charges. This is strong evidence of chilling surveillance and selective punishment against peaceful dissent.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Egypt: Release protesters and activists detained over Palestine solidarity","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"June 14, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-release-protesters-and-activists-detained-over-palestine-solidarity/","summary":"More than 123 people were arrested for peaceful Palestine solidarity or criticism of the Rafah closure, with reports of incommunicado detention and ill-treatment. That is strong evidence against allowing peaceful protest and community mobilization without retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"December 2, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"HRW says tens of thousands of refugee and asylum-seeking children were out of school because of residency bureaucracy, costs, discrimination, and limited free public education. This is not a protest case, but it shows the state maintained restrictive controls rather than broadly enabling community access and organization for vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.7","3B.6"]}]}
